title: Pip and the Plip-Plop Pond
moral: When we look after nature, every little creature has a happy home.
description: A windy night blows a whole picnic into Lily Pond, and the little frog's home is a mess! Pip, Hazel, Tumble and Nana Hoot test what floats and what sinks, with lots of PLOOPs, BOINGs and one giant sneeze. A funny animated story about caring for nature, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Last night, the wind went WHOOOOSH all over Clover Wood!
In the morning, Pip and Hazel skipped down to Lily Pond. And then... uh-oh!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Oh no! A whole picnic blew into the water!
Ribbit, said a little frog, very sadly. Hazel jumped! Her prickles went BOING!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Oh! Tee-hee... Poor little frog. His home is all messy!

narration.text: Nana Hoot flapped over with a big net. Her glasses slipped down her beak. Slip, slip, slip!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: The frogs and fish live here, so let's clean up! Some things FLOAT on top.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Some things SINK to the bottom. And that is why... zzzzz...
Nana? Nana!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! Hoo-hoo-HOO!

narration.text: Tumble brought a big glass tank for testing. Honk, honk!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I am the best guesser! This teeny pebble will float, because it is teeny!
PLOOP! Down, down, down it went. The pebble sinks!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Oh! Well, this big stick will sink, because it is big!
Bob, bob, bob! The big stick floats!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Then this spoon will... fly!
PLOOP! Oh, Pip! Spoons can't fly. The metal spoon sinks.
So, big things can float, and little things can sink! What about this red ball? Will it float or sink? What do YOU think?

narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! Pip, you caught a fox!

narration.text: But the net could not reach the sinkers, down at the bottom.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: My long trunk can help! Gently, gently.
Down went the trunk. Bloop, bloop, bloop!
First, up came a floppy pond weed. That's not it!
Next, up came a very surprised frog! Ribbit! HONK!
And the third time? The spoon! Hooray!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Sorry, little frog!

narration.text: But that pond weed tickled Tumble's trunk. Tickle, tickle... Uh-oh. You know what happens next, don't you?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH...

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: CHOOOOO!
WHOOSH! Waves went splish-splash! Hazel's prickles went BOING! And a pink flower landed right on the little frog's head!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! What a fine party hat!

narration.text: Look! The blue cup was floating, full of air.
But then the splashy water poured in. Glug, glug, glug!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: The cup is full of water now!
A cup full of water... will it float or sink? What do YOU think?
It sinks! Well done, you!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tumble, please lift it out, and tip it empty!
Tumble poured the water out. Plop! And the empty cup floated again!

narration.text: Ball, stick, spoon and cup. Soon they were all in the basket. Count them! One, two, three, four!
The water sparkled. The ducks came home. The dragonflies danced.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Next time, we tie our picnic down tight. Then the pond stays clean!
The little frog hopped on his lily pad and sang. Ribbit-ribbit-ribbit!

narration.text: That night, the moon shone on the clean, shiny pond.
Ribbit, ribbit, sang all the frogs. It sounded just like thank you.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Looking after the pond is super-duper!
Tumble did a happy trunk HONK... and Nana woke up.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! Hoo-hoo!
